scope: Append-only fixture-only pre-data analysis lock; not an external custody verification, held-out catalog, real trial admission, scorer, aggregate, confidence interval, provider, tool dispatch, chemistry result, replication, paper, training, release, or SOTA result.

supported: The fixture-only module hash-binds the frozen P5 surface and refuses its defined synthetic matrix and policy inconsistencies.
qualified: The opaque commitments are prospective integrity controls only; they do not verify any external source or result.
unresolved: External custody, complete analysis decisions, actual receipts, deterministic scoring, intervals, replication, and all P5/P6 material gates.
rejected: This receipt establishes a held-out outcome, component benefit, chemical validity, comparator result, approval consumption, paper readiness, or SOTA.

failure_ledger.failure: P5 fixed the factorial surface and broad bootstrap pins without binding all material policy choices before data.
failure_ledger.hypothesis: Opaque decision bindings can expose missing policy without a scorer selecting it implicitly.
failure_ledger.minimal_change: Add fixture-only decision and metric-definition hashes, with unresolved choices explicit.
failure_ledger.evidence: P5 protocol, P5-F2/P5-F5/P5-F8, and focused unresolved-decision checks.
failure_ledger.result: Unresolved choices return predata_analysis_incomplete and do not make P5 evaluable.
failure_ledger.limitation: A digest does not define an estimand, interval convention, contrast, or evidence source.
failure_ledger.rollback_boundary: Replace only through a new authorized preregistration revision with explicit decisions.

failure_ledger.failure: Future receipts could mix configurations, repetitions, surface controls, custody, policy, or grader revisions before analysis.
failure_ledger.hypothesis: A typed opaque 8 x 3 matrix can reject structural drift before a scorer runs.
failure_ledger.minimal_change: Add prospective digest-only keys and exact pair/repetition coverage checks.
failure_ledger.evidence: Focused duplicate, visible-development reuse, missing-pair/repetition, and digest-drift fixtures.
failure_ledger.result: Defined structural defects are refused without a score or interval.
failure_ledger.limitation: The fixture cannot prove custody, receipt truth, or a real outcome.
failure_ledger.rollback_boundary: Retire only for a reviewed external-receipt validator with equivalent or stronger controls.

failure_ledger.failure: A synthetic success-like row could be misread as evidence or used to promote a component.
failure_ledger.hypothesis: Hard-coded ineligibility and conclusion refusal prevent structural checks becoming a result claim.
failure_ledger.minimal_change: Keep P5 evaluation and adoption false and reject enable-default or SOTA intents while gates are red.
failure_ledger.result: Synthetic input remains external_evidence_required with the unchanged P5 blocker set.
failure_ledger.limitation: No P5-G2 through P5-G5 condition is observed.
failure_ledger.rollback_boundary: Do not relax without independent custody, complete receipts, qualifying gates, and separate authority.

failure_ledger.failure: The first red-line vocabulary omitted fabricated evidence despite it being a required integrity category.
failure_ledger.hypothesis: A named fixture event must cover every required integrity category before future outcomes are shaped.
failure_ledger.minimal_change: Add fabricated_evidence and parameterize the existing conclusion-refusal fixture over it and red-gate terminal success.
failure_ledger.evidence: Source audit after the initial 7-pass focused run, followed by the corrected 8-pass rerun.
failure_ledger.result: Both named synthetic red-line records are accepted as retained failure evidence and cannot support adoption.
failure_ledger.limitation: The two cases are fixtures and do not establish an observed violation or a live policy control.
failure_ledger.rollback_boundary: Replace only with a reviewed event registry that is a strict semantic superset.
